title: TRICARE Select Deductible on Lines Reprocessed for Other Health Insurance - Questions and Answers
content:
**Provision.** Where a **TRICARE Select** line reprocessed for other health insurance has a service class in the tier's deductible-exempt service classes or the line is network preventive care, it takes no deductible; where the tier's individual deductible less the deductible already met is less than the amount cost-shared, it takes that remainder, never below zero, rounded to the cent; otherwise it takes the whole amount cost-shared. The deductible already met for a reprocessed line is the deductible applied on the enrollment's claim lines less the deductible their reversals withdrew.

## Questions the rule answers

**Which lines take no deductible?** A line whose service class is exempt on the tier, and network preventive care.

| Tier | Individual deductible (US dollars) | Exempt service classes |
|---|---|---|
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-1 to E-4) | 50.00 | preventive care; emergency room visit |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group A (E-5 and Above) | 150.00 | preventive care; emergency room visit |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-1 to E-4) | 61.00 | preventive care; emergency room visit |
| TRICARE Select Active Duty Family Member Group B (E-5 and Above) | 183.00 | preventive care; emergency room visit |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group A | 150.00 | preventive care |
| TRICARE Select Retiree Group B | 183.00 | preventive care; emergency room visit |

**How is the deductible already met counted?** As the deductible applied on the enrollment's claim lines, less the deductible withdrawn by their reversals - so a line withdrawn for other health insurance no longer counts toward it.

**What does a line take when the remainder is smaller than the amount cost-shared?** The remainder, never below zero. Hypothetical: on TRICARE Select Retiree Group B, 183.00 less 160.00 already met leaves 23.00; a line cost-shared on 200.00 takes 23.00.

**And when the remainder is not smaller?** The whole amount cost-shared: with 183.00 still open, a line cost-shared on 183.00 or on 40.00 takes all of it.
